units.source_text: 我一边望着母亲系着腰带、迈着碎步、无精打采的背影，一边在寻思：

en.t: As I watched my mother's lifeless figure from behind, tying her sash and taking short, shuffling steps, I was thinking:

units.source_text: 是什么东西让母亲变得格外的丑陋的呢？

en.t: What was it that had made my mother so especially ugly?

units.source_text: 让母亲变得丑陋的……原来就是希望。

en.t: What had made my mother ugly... was, as it turned out, hope.

units.source_text: 这种希望如顽固的皮癣，潮乎乎呈淡红色，不断使人发痒，不输给世上任何东西地盘踞在肮脏的皮肤上。

en.t: This hope was like a stubborn patch of ringworm, damp and pale red, constantly making one itch, clinging to filthy skin with a tenacity second to nothing in the world.

units.source_text: 这就是一种无可救药的希望。

en.t: This was a kind of hope beyond all cure.
